About Song - Data & AI Accenture Song uses AI, proprietary customer data, and product platforms to help clients improve customer experience and drive measurable growth across marketing, sales, commerce, and service. From strategy through execution, Song Data & AI helps organizations build and operationalize advanced capabilities - covering customer data unification, predictive analytics, and Generative AI (including agentic use cases) - to enable smarter decisioning like personalization and "next best action," faster content and experience delivery, and more effective commerce and customer engagement. What's In It For You? Join a worldwide network of full stack, cloud, data, and AI engineers building secure digital products and AI-enabled enterprise applications. Access world-class training, mentorship, and certifications across modern front-end and back-end engineering, cloud-native development, DevSecOps, data platforms, and applied AI. Work on high-visibility engagements across Marketing, Sales, Commerce, Customer Service, and Digital Products - creating applications that make data, ML, Generative AI, and agentic capabilities usable at scale. Contribute to Accenture's reusable user-interface components, application services, integration patterns, reference implementations, testing assets, and engineering playbooks. What You Will Do As a Full Stack Engineering Consultant, you will own the hands-on design, build, testing, deployment, and support of assigned application modules and workstreams. You will create responsive user experiences and scalable services, integrate governed data and ML/AI capabilities, and guide junior team members within agreed architecture, security, and delivery standards. Analyze business, user, and technical requirements and translate them into user stories, acceptance criteria, API contracts, detailed designs, and executable engineering tasks. Build responsive, accessible, and reusable web interfaces using modern JavaScript or TypeScript frameworks such as React, Angular, Vue, or Next.js. Develop secure back-end services, microservices, and APIs using one or more enterprise stacks such as Java and Spring Boot, .NET, Node.js and NestJS, or Python and FastAPI. Implement application data models and persistence using relational and NoSQL databases, caching, search, object storage, and messaging services appropriate to the use case. Integrate applications with enterprise systems, identity services, APIs, files, event streams, and third-party platforms using synchronous and asynchronous integration patterns. Apply data engineering know-how to application delivery - including SQL, schema design, data contracts, app-specific ingestion or transformation, data quality checks, lineage awareness, and consumption of lakehouse or warehouse data products. Integrate ML and AI capabilities through model endpoints, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, embeddings and vector search, agent or tool APIs, structured outputs, feedback capture, and human-in-the-loop workflows in collaboration with ML/AI engineers. Implement engineering practices covering Git, code reviews, automated unit, integration and end-to-end testing, CI/CD, containerization, cloud deployment, configuration, and release management. Design and operate for security, privacy, accessibility, performance, resilience, observability, and cost; troubleshoot defects and production incidents across the application stack. Own an assigned module or workstream, coordinate day-to-day technical activities, review deliverables, and guide Analysts or Senior Analysts. Engage client product owners, designers, architects, data teams, and AI teams through requirement workshops, design walkthroughs, sprint reviews, demonstrations, and issue resolution. Contribute reusable code, components, technical documentation, reference implementations, and practice knowledge assets. About Firstsource: Firstsource Solutions Limited, an RP-Sanjiv Goenka Group company (NSE: FSL, BSE: 532809, Reuters: FISO.BO, Bloomberg: FSOL:IN), is a specialized global business process services partner, providing transformational solutions and services spanning the customer lifecycle across Healthcare, Banking and Financial Services, Communications, Media and Technology, Retail, and other diverse industries. With an established presence in the US, the UK, India, Mexico, Australia, South Africa, and the Philippines, we make it happen for our clients, solving their biggest challenges with hyper-focused, domain-centered teams and cutting-edge tech, data, and analytics. Our real-world practitioners work collaboratively to deliver future-focused outcomes. Job Brief We are seeking a highly experienced and hands-on Lead AI Engineer to drive the design, development, and delivery of enterprise-scale AI products. This role combines technical leadership with deep engineering expertise, requiring active involvement in product feature architecture, full-stack application development, AI/ML model integration, code reviews, release management, and engineering best practices within our AI Product Engineering team. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Python, Machine Learning, Cloud Technologies, and modern full-stack development, with a proven ability to lead technical teams while remaining actively engaged in coding. They should be passionate about building scalable, production-ready AI products, mentoring engineers, establishing technical standards, and collaborating with Product Managers and cross-functional teams to transform product requirements into robust, high-performance AI-powered product features. Mandatory Technical Skills 4 to 6+ years of hands-on software development experience with strong coding expertise. Strong programming experience in Python (Mandatory). Experience with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG, AI Agents, and Agentic AI frameworks. Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or similar frameworks. Experience with Vector Databases and Enterprise AI platforms. Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Gemini, Cursor, or equivalent. Proven experience in designing, developing, and deploying enterprise-grade applications. Strong expertise in Full Stack Development: Backend (Python, FastAPI, Flask, Django) and Frontend (React.js, Angular, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3). Experience developing and maintaining REST APIs and Microservices. Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), SOLID Principles, Design Patterns, and Domain-Driven Design (DDD). Hands-on experience building, training, fine-tuning, and deploying Machine Learning models. Experience with ML frameworks such as Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, and XGBoost. Experience deploying AI/ML solutions into production environments and implementing MLOps practices. Strong hands-on experience with AWS and/or Azure Cloud Platforms (Mandatory). Experience with cloud-native development, containerization, and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines, DevOps, and Infrastructure as Code. Strong understanding of distributed systems, event-driven architecture, scalability, performance optimization, and security best practices. Experience working with relational and NoSQL databases. Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Roles And Responsibilities Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable full-stack applications using Python and modern front-end frameworks. Build and deploy Machine Learning and AI-powered solutions for enterprise use cases. Actively contribute to coding, code reviews, debugging, and performance optimization activities. Develop and maintain REST APIs, microservices, and cloud-native applications. Design scalable, secure, and maintainable software architectures following industry best practices. Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines, DevOps, and MLOps processes. Deploy, monitor, and optimize applications and ML models on AWS and/or Azure. Ensure high standards of code quality through automated testing, peer reviews, and engineering best practices. Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues across application, infrastructure, and data layers. Drive continuous improvement in architecture, development processes, security, scalability, and operational efficiency. Mentor and guide team members on technical design, coding standards, and engineering best practices. Stay updated with emerging technologies and recommend innovative solutions to enhance products and platforms. Work in Agile teams and contribute to sprint planning, estimation, and successful delivery of project milestones. Own and evolve specific modules/features within Firstsource's AI product suite, maintaining a technical backlog in partnership with Product Management. Conduct usability, performance, and scalability testing across product releases and drive iterative improvements based on internal and client feedback loops. Support release planning, versioning, and product documentation for engineering and support teams. Experience & Education 4-6+ years of overall experience. Master's or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or an Engineering discipline. ⚠️ Disclaimer: Firstsource follows a fair, transparent, and merit-based hiring process. We never ask for money at any stage. Beware of fraudulent offers and always verify through our official channels or @firstsource.com email addresses. AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies. Job Title: Forward Deployed Solution Engineer - Web Technology (React, Angular) Location: Hyderabad, India Employment Type: Full Time, regular, hybrid work arrangement The job The Forward Deployed Solution Engineer owns a defined technical workstream within an FDE engagement. Working within agreed architecture and standards, the role applies customer domain context to configure, integrate, test, troubleshoot, validate, document, and hand over AVEVA solutions using real customer data, systems, and constraints. The role is accountable for quality, timelines, reusable technical outputs, and timely risk escalation. Key Responsibilities Own a defined FDE technical workstream from implementation through validation and handover. Build, configure, integrate, test, troubleshoot, and adapt AVEVA solutions in real customer environments. Apply established architecture, standards, methods, and governance to deliver reliable outcomes. Clarify requirements, dependencies, risks, feasibility, and implementation needs for the workstream. Implement creative and out of the box solutioning strategies against identified product feature gaps Resolve non-routine technical issues across APIs, integrations, data flows, configuration, performance, security, and deployment. Support demonstrations, acceptance testing, performance checks, validation, and production-readiness activities. Create reusable configurations, connectors, templates, AI patterns, implementation notes, and troubleshooting guidance. Coordinate with peers and adjacent teams, guide less-experienced contributors where appropriate, and escalate material risks early. Essential Skills Typically, 5-8 years of relevant experience, or equivalent demonstrated capability in industrial technology implementation and technical project delivery. Hands-on capability in AVEVA solution configuration, integration, testing, troubleshooting, validation, and handover. Working knowledge of AVEVA products, customer domain workflows, industrial data, customer systems, APIs, cloud/edge, security, performance, and deployment constraints. Practical domain awareness of the customer’s operating model, workflows, KPIs, and value drivers, so the solution solves the right industrial problem. Ability to work within agreed architecture, standards, methodologies, governance, and engagement priorities. Sound judgment in resolving non-routine technical issues and escalating risks early. Clear customer-facing and cross-team communication skills. Developing AI Agents, Skills, Tools, Plugins etc. using any one of the agentic framework preferably MAF AI tools for SDLC like Copilot & practical awareness of AI/ML and Generative AI use cases within agreed technical, safety, and governance guidance. Accountability for quality, schedule, documentation, testing evidence, reusable outputs, and reliable handover. What Success Looks Like Defined FDE technical workstreams are delivered reliably, on time, and in line with agreed architecture, standards, and customer success criteria. AVEVA solutions are configured, integrated, tested, validated, documented, and handed over with clear evidence of quality and operational readiness. Non-routine technical issues are resolved using sound judgment, with material risks, dependencies, and trade-offs escalated early. Reusable configurations, templates, troubleshooting notes, implementation guidance, and AI or integration patterns improve delivery quality for future FDE engagements. Peers, Architects, Leads, and customer-facing stakeholders view the role as a dependable technical contributor who builds confidence through practical execution, clear communication, and reliable handover. Services at AVEVA Our dynamic global team of 700+ engineers, developers, consultants, solution architects and project managers are at the forefront of delivering AVEVA cutting-edge solutions to customers. The work is complex and technical, but immensely rewarding: we empower customers to harness the full transformative potential of AVEVA’s solutions. If you’re analytical, pragmatic, and driven to make a tangible impact on the sustainability of the industrial sector, our team is the perfect place for you. You’ll also be joining an award-winning workplace. AVEVA is Great Place to Work® Certified™ in multiple countries, reflecting the culture our people create every day. Explore our awards and recognition .
